notes.title: Exclusive 'Trust Me, Not Her' Merchandise Now Available
notes.content:
[h2]You can now support me on Patreon[/h2]

Hello all, I am very excited to present to you, the first-ever Merch items of 'Trust Me, Not Her'.

They are available as rewards on my newly launched [url=https://www.patreon.com/NerdyBirdStudios][b]PATREON[/b][/url], along with several other awesome benefits.

If you're eager for the release of this Visual Novel, then check out these marvelous merchandise previews:

[h2]Trust Me, Not Her T-Shirt[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41326190/9a9213c8792d22dbc1c80cb6f5b52adfa9a61d6c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41326190/341065bab29a88d5cf0a8ab918fe53870b7c63c8.png[/img]

[h2]Xyla and Willow Character Mugs[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41326190/2ead852a5307e9dda2733b45d372c525472e0c88.png[/img]

[h2]Adorable Chibi Mini Prints[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41326190/c0a14ddc81bba5ab199ceea11c1b31a7f0bb9122.png[/img]

[h2]Trust Me, Not Her Poster[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41326190/167bf6de4a0669449c48dbefd448e87e154a31ab.png[/img]

I thank everyone who considers becoming a Patron tremendously.
Trust Me, Not Her™, and my previous game, Potion Commotion, are both Free-To-Play, so the generous support I receive from the community is extraordinarily valuable, allowing me to keep creating the best content I can.

So again, if you're interested in supporting my work, then please follow the [b][url=https://www.patreon.com/NerdyBirdStudios]LINK[/url][/b].

And that's all for now, thanks for your time, and feel free to join the Official NerdyBird Studios Discord Server if you haven't already [url=https://discord.com/invite/qEZ8f8gT65][b]HERE[/b][/url].

Kind regards,
Luke of NerdyBird Studios.
